text:
Alex Chen: FYI Escalation from Sales — OrionAI seeing large drop in rerank precision after last week's model swap. ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/ORION-1245 :grimacing:
Maria Gomez: got it. severity?
Alex Chen: Customer says top-1 accuracy on their evaluation prompts fell from 86% -> 62% after switching to redwood-embed-v2-quant. They flagged in-prod search results for 2k users.
Jamal Khan: tagging eng/runtime and product. can we get a quick repro or an eval set?
Alex Chen: attached snippet of their eval run and a small sample set inline: 
```
query: "patient history summary"
expected_doc: doc_123
score_before: 0.92
score_after: 0.41
```
Maria Gomez: CS Bot created ORION-1245 and linked support logs (see bot).
CS Bot: New ticket ORION-1245 created by Maria Gomez: https://support.redwood.ai/t/ORION-1245 — priority P1 if customer financial impact > $50k/month.
Alex Chen: Customer says impact is revenue-significant, but they asked for mitigation before pricing conversation — they want either rollback or config change.
Olivia Park: Product here. Need quick triage: is this embedding drift (model change) or a post-processing rerank bug?
Rey Thompson: Eng note — we rolled out redwood-embed-v2-quant to dedicated clusters last Wed. Known delta: quantization + a different normalization step in the pipeline. Could be either.
Jamal Khan: immediate suggestion: pin OrionAI to redwood-embed-v1 for dedicated and schedule canary rollback for host. Will that buy time?
Olivia Park: That seems reasonable short-term. For product prioritization we need reproducible numbers, root cause hypothesis, and target launch criteria for fix or formal rollback.
Alex Chen: I asked customer for their full eval set and gave them v1 pin instructions. They replied "Yes please pin for now".
Maria Gomez: Customer pinned to v1 — they confirmed partial restoration of relevance.
Olivia Park: Ok. ACTIONS: 1) Eng to run differential eval on customer dataset between v1, v2, v2-quant and report precision@1/recall@10 + embedding cosine distributions. 2) Eng to check normalization change & quantization path for potential scattering. 3) Product to scope spec: acceptable precision delta <= 3 points, rollout criteria = pass A/B on customer eval + automated eval harness, QA signoff. 4) CS to confirm rollback window and customer SLAs.
Rey Thompson: I can run the diffs today. If quantization is culprit we can ship a compatibility flag that keeps pre-v2 normalization for a quick patch. Est 2–3 days for patch and 1-day canary.
Olivia Park: Prioritization: mark ORION-1245 as P0 for upcoming sprint triage and add to backlog with tag "rerank-regression". Product will draft acceptance criteria doc.
Jamal Khan: Please add short repro steps and a minimal dataset to the ticket so we can automate the eval.
Alex Chen: adding repro to ticket now. customer provided 120 queries + labeled top doc. uploading...
Maria Gomez: Customer asked for ETA and wants weekly updates.
Olivia Park: We'll commit to daily updates until resolved. Also scheduling 30m sync after Rey posts diff results.
Rey Thompson: Diff posted to the ticket: link https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ORION-1245?focusedCommentId=1001 — preliminary shows v2-quant cosine variance spike and 24% drop in precision@1 vs v1.
Olivia Park: Thanks — that confirms quantization impact. Next steps: fast patch + compatibility flag, longer-term: add quantization-aware calibration to model onboarding + gating.
Alex Chen: I'll reply to customer with the mitigation plan and rollback confirmation.
Maria Gomez: Closing loop: CS will verify after canary and reopen if any residual issues. :thumbsup:
Olivia Park: Product will draft launch criteria and a small spec for eng. Assigning to Rey for the tech lead on the fix.
Rey Thompson: Roger. Will update ticket with timeline and PR link.
Alex Chen: thanks everyone — good triage.
